The '''Dustig Trace''', also known as the '''Dustig Trade Route''', was a short [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that, by [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], linked the [[Kath system/Legends|Kath]], [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare]], and [[Demos system/Legends|Demos systems]]. By [[3702 BBY]], the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] linked the Dustig Trace to the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]], and several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later the former hyperlane was also connected to the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. Eventually, the Dustig Trace was absorbed into the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] and, around [[3643 BBY]], a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] consortium gained a monopoly on the shorter route.

==Description==
The Dustig Trace,<ref name="TEA" /> alternately known as the Dustig Trade Route,<ref name="See, Hear, Speak">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|See, Hear, Speak}}</ref> was a short but useful [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as a [[praedium]]. It ran from the [[Kath system/Legends|Kath system]] to the [[Demos system/Legends|Demos system]], passing through the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]] in the process.<ref name="TEA" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], all three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] constituted a part of the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]]<ref name="MidRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="TEA" /> with the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route additionally sharing its name with the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Dustig system/Legends|Dustig system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Malastare_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Dustig Trace played a role in the history of the planet Malastare.]]
[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] searched the southern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for analogues to the northern quadrant's [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], and consequently the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] became a member of the Republic in [[8000 BBY]]. Eventually, the establishment of the Dustig Trace gave rise to the Republic's [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] enclave known as the [[Dustig Pocket]]. The westward portion of the area in which the Dustig Trace would eventually be located was explored by the Republic between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]], while the eastern section of that region was explored by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Dustig Trace had been formed by the [[Inter-Sith Wars period|time period]] between the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the [[New Sith Wars]],<ref name="ISW" /> specifically by [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the scout [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] began [[Star map/Legends|charting]] new hyperspace routes in order to better connect the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] northern and southern quadrants. Between [[3703 BBY]] and [[3702 BBY]], she connected the mostly [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]- and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]&ndash;based [[Brentaal–Denon Route]] to the Demos system.<ref name="TEA" />

Later, as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]] of [[3701 BBY]]&ndash;[[3699 BBY]] that took place while Kallea spent years stranded on the [[Map/Legends|uncharted]] world [[Nuvar]], the Malastare system was further linked to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Colu system]] on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. In [[3693 BBY]], the Dustig Trace was merged into the resultant super-hyperroute known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], which resulted in a further boost to Malastare's status as a hub of [[Merchant/Legends|trading]]. Over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the Hydian Way shifted away from the Demos system to instead run through the [[Pax system/Legends|Pax system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and the Mid Rim's [[ZeHeth system/Legends|ZeHeth system]] before passing through Malastare.<ref name="TEA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "See, Hear, Speak" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> three trading consortiums vied for a monopoly on the Dustig Trace. In order to achieve that, each of them offered secret deals to an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A companion of that individual subsequently made secret overtures to all three consortiums&mdash;thus maximizing their own benefits&mdash;before ultimately assisting one of the organizations acquire the monopoly.<ref name="See, Hear, Speak" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Dustig Trace was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> The hyperlane was subsequently mentioned in a Diplomacy Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which introduced an alternate name for the route, the Dustig Trade Route. However, information on the mission's outcome was eventually removed from the game.<ref name="See, Hear, Speak" />
